# UI Audit — Reminders (2026-11-02) ## Stack - Framework: Vanilla JS + FastAPI serving one Jinja2 template (`app/templates/index.html`) - Build tool: none - CSS: plain CSS in `app/static/styles.css` (13 lines) plus inline `style=` in the template - State: none (the list is re-fetched and re-rendered as HTML strings; the server keeps an in-memory list) - Design tokens: `app/static/styles.css` (`:root` with 4 variables) - Run: `uvicorn app.main:app --reload` (run from the project root, because the paths are relative to it) → http://127.0.0.1:8000 (uvicorn's default; no README or Procfile confirms it) - Checks: none found ## Pages / Routes (top 10) SPA mode: one page, three client-side tabs. - `/` — `app/templates/index.html` (the only HTML page) - Tab "Today" — `#today` in `index.html`, filled by `app/static/app.js` (reminders not yet done) - Tab "All reminders" — `#all` in `index.html`, filled by `app/static/app.js` - Tab "Settings" — `#settings` in `index.html` (notification time field and Save button) - `/api/reminders` (GET) — `app/main.py` (data for the tabs, not a page) - `/api/reminders/{id}/done` (POST) — `app/main.py` (the "Done" button) ## Style approach Styling is split between a tiny stylesheet and inline `style=` attributes on 12 elements in the template. Colors are hard-coded hex values (about 17 distinct). The four `--color-*` / `--space-2` tokens in `:root` are defined but never used with `var(...)`. ## Pain points ### 🔴 High - Not responsive: `` is fixed at `width: 800px`, `.view` at `760px`, the settings input at `300px`, and there is no ``. On a phone the page is cut off or zoomed out. - Tokens exist but are unused: `--color-primary` and `--color-success` hold the same values as the hard-coded `#2b6cb0` and `#38a169`, but nothing references them. Wiring the tokens in is the highest-leverage fix for the new look. - Accessibility basics missing: no `alt` on the logo `` (and `/static/logo.png` does not exist, so it shows a broken image), no `lang` on ``, no `
`, `
` or `
`, no `aria-` attributes at all, and the tabs are plain buttons with no selected state shown to the user or to screen readers. - Contrast: white on the green Save button (`#38a169`, about 3.3:1) and the grey `#777` helper text and `#a0aec0` finished items are below the 4.5:1 readable minimum. - Settings does nothing real: "Save" only shows a browser `alert()`. Nothing is sent to or stored by the backend. The redesign must keep this behaviour visible or the Developer must add an endpoint. ### 🟡 Medium - No loading or error state: the reminders `fetch` (page load) and the Done `fetch` (`markDone`) show no spinner, disabled button or error message; the tabs stay blank until data arrives or if the request fails. - No empty state: `.empty` is styled in the CSS but never used, so an empty Today or All tab is a blank area. - "Today" lists every not-done reminder, regardless of its due date. Confirm with the Stakeholder whether that is intended before the design shows "today" differently. - Reminder titles are inserted with `innerHTML` without escaping (`app.js`). A title containing HTML would be rendered as markup. This is a Developer matter, not a design one. - The reminder rows show a "Done" button even on rows already done in the "All reminders" tab. ### 🟢 Low - Hard-coded English text throughout; no i18n markers. Fine for a one-language app, so only a note. - Tab and button styles are set partly in CSS and partly inline (for example three different grey text colors on the tab buttons), so they look inconsistent. - No `` beyond "Reminders", no favicon, no page description. ## Recommendation Confirm Scenario C: the stack is tiny and healthy (all files well under 500 lines), so keep FastAPI + Jinja + vanilla JS and restyle it. Note for the brief: the design must cover the three tabs, the Done action, and the Save action in Settings (currently not persisted).

The stylesheet defines colour and spacing tokens, but nothing uses them; every colour is hard-coded. About 16 distinct colours are in use, several of them near-duplicate blues and greys. ## Pain points ### 🔴 High - Not responsive: `body` is fixed at `width: 800px` and `.view` at `760px`. There is no `` and no media queries, so the page breaks on phones. - Tokens exist but are unused: `--color-primary`, `--color-success`, `--color-text`, `--space-2` are defined, yet none is referenced (`var(` count is 0) while colours are repeated inline (`#2b6cb0`, `#38a169`) and in CSS (`#3182ce` for buttons, a different blue). - No accessibility basics: no `lang` on ``, no `
`/`
`/`
`, tabs are plain buttons with no `role="tab"`/`aria-selected`, the notification input has no label, and `` has no `alt`. - Broken logo: `app/static/logo.png` does not exist, so the header shows a broken image. - Reminder titles are inserted into the page with `innerHTML` unescaped (`app/static/app.js`), so a title containing HTML would be rendered as markup. It is a code issue the Developer should know about, and the redesign should not carry it over. ### 🟡 Medium - No loading or error state: the reminders list is empty until the fetch returns, and a failed fetch or "Done" click shows nothing. The "Done" button stays active while the request runs. All three spot-checked calls (`loadReminders`, `markDone`, none for Save) lack this. - Settings "Save" does nothing real: it only shows a browser `alert()`. No backend route exists for it, so a design cannot assume a working setting (matters for the integration plan). - No empty state: `.empty` is defined in CSS but never used, so an empty Today list is a blank area. - No tests, lint or typecheck, so `design-port` has nothing automatic to run before showing a Screen. ### 🟢 Low - Tab buttons give no sign of which tab is active, and tab text colours (`#333`, `#444`, `#555`) differ without reason. - Text is hard-coded English with no i18n markers (fine if the app stays single-language). - Page `` is the generic "Reminders" and there is no favicon. ## Recommendation Confirm scenario C: the app is tiny (about 100 lines in total), the stack is simple, and a new look can be ported into the existing template and stylesheet.
